paper_title: Learning to Reason under Off-Policy Guidance
caption_used: Training rewards of LLaMA-3.1 8B on the Easy and Hard training sets, displayed as two vertically stacked line plots. In the Easy Training Set (top panel), both Llama-On-Policy-Easy (teal) and Llama-LUFFY-Easy (red) start near 0.0 and increase over 500 steps, with LUFFY reaching approximately 0.4 and On-Policy reaching approximately 0.35 at step 500. In the Hard Training Set (bottom panel), Llama-LUFFY-Hard shows steady improvement from near 0.0 to approximately 0.2 by step 500, while Llama-On-Policy-Hard initially rises to approximately 0.05 before declining back toward 0.0 after step 150. Notably, the performance gap between the two methods is substantially wider on the Easy set, where LUFFY maintains a consistent lead of approximately 0.10 throughout training, compared to the Hard set where their trajectories only clearly diverge after step 200.
model_annotation:
In the first plot, known as the Easy Training Set, the x-axis is labeled "Steps" and spans from 0 to 500. The y-axis is labeled "Training Rewards". There are two lines in this plot: one is teal and labeled "Llama-On-Policy-Easy" and the other is red and labeled "Llama-LUFFY-Easy". Both lines start at approximately 0.0 and show a general upward trend as the number of steps increases. The Llama-LUFFY-Easy line ends with a value around 0.4, while the Llama-On-Policy-Easy ends near 0.35 by step 500. The Llama-LUFFY-Easy line demonstrates a more prominent increase and faster pace in reaching higher training rewards compared to the Llama-On-Policy-Easy line, which shows a slower, more gradual increase. 

In the second plot, referred to as the Hard Training Set, the x-axis is also labeled "Steps" ranging from 0 to 500, while the y-axis is the same as the first plot, indicating "Training Rewards". In this plot, there are also two lines: one teal labeled "Llama-On-Policy-Hard" and one red labeled "Llama-LUFFY-Hard". Both lines start at around 0.0, but the teal line reaches a peak of about 0.05 before dipping back to near 0.0 around step 150, while the red line shows steady improvement and concludes just above 0.1 near step 500. The performance gap between the two methods is less pronounced in this set, as indicated by more overlapping and less divergence between the lines, with the divergence becoming more evident after step 200.
